summary: Compact terminal workspace tabs show activity and one attention suffix

replay.detail: No replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: Badge chrome is derived from current observations and is not persisted.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or coordinated upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: Existing workspace layouts remain compatible. Tabs omit kind letters and loading placeholders, and merge question and attention counts into one suffix.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator actions or configuration changes.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
